c8d93ccac06433c0: curiosidade-viral is a kit (a "skill" for Claude Code or Codex) that makes vertical curiosity reels without anyone appearing on camera: a voice explains while the screen shows an everyday object up close. It’s for anyone who wants to create a short-form content account without filming or editing. The kit checks the hook before you spend, asks for your approval on a storyboard, records the voice on your computer, and assembles the video with code. It also includes two agents that read messages and ad metrics and only make recommendations. You need Node.js, ffmpeg, Python, and Claude Code or Codex.
